checklist.criterion: Method and its field are unified into a discriminated union: A `"card"` variant carries only `cardLast4`, a `"bank_transfer"` variant carries only `bankReference` — no member has both or neither field ambiguously optional
Status and its field are unified into a discriminated union: A `"failed"` variant carries `failureReason`, a `"refunded"` variant carries `refundedAt`, and `"pending"`/`"completed"` carry neither

The combined type rejects the original nonsensical example: The redesigned `Payment` type structurally prevents constructing a value with `method: "bank_transfer"` and `cardLast4` set, or `status: "completed"` and `failureReason` set
Compile-error case is demonstrated: A comment shows that the original `bad` example (or an equivalent) no longer compiles against the redesigned type
No `any` or unsafe assertions introduced: The redesign contains no `any`, `@ts-ignore`, or unchecked `as` assertions
